brand.name: WeCare

consent.title: Cookies & privacy
consent.body: WeCare uses essential storage to run the site. With your consent we also measure how the assessment and checkout are used, so we can improve them. No data is sold.

essential.label: Essential
essential.desc: Needed for the site to work: your language, cart, questionnaire progress, sign-in and this choice. Cannot be turned off.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.desc: Anonymous usage measurement so we can see where the guided flow can be improved. No health details, names or contact data.

consent.saved: Preference saved. You can change it anytime under Cookie settings in the footer.

footer.disclaimer: WeCare provides a medical review and, where medically appropriate, a prescription. Not everyone receives a prescription.
footer.emergencyDisclaimer: WeCare does not replace emergency care.

medicalNotice.heading: Important information about medical cannabis
medicalNotice.body: Medical cannabis is a prescription medicine. Like any medicine it can have side effects: commonly tiredness, dizziness, reduced concentration, or interactions with other medicines. How it affects you is individual.
medicalNotice.body2: It is used only after a medical review and under medical guidance, and it does not replace a standard therapy your doctor considers necessary. Never start, stop or change a medicine on your own.
medicalNotice.disclaimer: The information on this site is general and does not replace individual medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. For health concerns, speak with your doctor.
